title: MF 135 · Perkins AD3.152 - Workshop Manual p.80
text:
LUBRICATION SYSTEM-M.4

                         To renew lubricating oil filter canister
                         1.   Remove the filter canister with a strap wrench
                              or similar tool and discard the canister (see fig.
                              M4).
                         2.   Clean the filter head.
                         3.   Add clean engine lubricating oil to the new
                              canister.
